u0: No zombie has been killed yet (0 of 2 required). The active objective is to find a zombie and move onto it to score the first kill; all other events leave progress at zero.
u1: Exactly one zombie has been killed (1 of 2). The active objective is to find another zombie and move onto it for the second kill, which completes the goal; no event can reduce the count.
u2: At least two zombies have been killed, so the goal is complete and this is the terminal state. No further kill objective remains for the reward machine; any later actions only affect the environment.
